approach: Static recompilation of the PPU and Cell SPU code to C/C++ (custom lifters), on a reimplementation of the PS3 OS and libraries. Metal renderer, VideoToolbox for cutscenes, CoreAudio, GameController input. Runs natively on Apple Silicon (macOS); Android (Vulkan) and iOS (Metal) builds are experimental. No emulator and no JIT.
help: SCREAM mixer: audio clock is still partly host-driven
Android and iOS builds are experimental (tablet and iPhone runs reach the menu and early gameplay)
Chapters after the Colossus of Rhodes are not verified
notes: macOS is the primary target: boot, intro videos, main menu, New Game, memory-card saves and combat in the Rhodes palace run natively at 45-60 fps on Apple Silicon; the Colossus fight is playable. Android (measured on a tablet) and iOS (measured on an iPhone) are experimental ports of the same runtime. No game code or assets are in this repository: the setup kit builds on your machine from your own copy of the game. See the README for the full status table.
